color_palette.description: 柔美、生活感、现代女性——粉+奶+金，与 ST08 的黑黄工业感完全相反

mask_params.reason: 布料、编织带、软质边缘——羽化要比 ST08 大（电子产品硬边 4px → 布料软边 10px）

prompt_fragments.positive_style_base: lifestyle product photography, soft natural light, warm cozy atmosphere, magazine editorial style, hyper-realistic fabric texture rendering, 8K resolution, commercial quality
prompt_fragments.negative_base: cartoon, masculine tough lighting, harsh shadows, industrial, low quality, blurry, watermark, deformed bag, wrong strap count, extra pockets, low-poly
scene_pool: minimalist cafe with warm wood and greenery
airport lounge with natural light streaming in
cozy hotel room bed with linen bedding
sunlit apartment entryway with marble floor
hiking trail at sunrise with dewy grass
urban street cafe outdoor seating morning
prompt_fragments.human_presence: occasional — young woman mid-20s to mid-30s, lifestyle candid moments, face can be visible but often 3/4 back view holding the bag

typography.headline_font: Playfair Display Bold / Cormorant Garamond / Freight Display

notes_for_future: 与 ST08 的关键差异：光线柔和（5600K vs 5000K）、fill 高（0.85 vs 0.6）、无 rim light（off vs on）、羽化大（10 vs 4）
场景池大量人物元素——需要特别注意 human_presence 的 consistency，避免诡异面部
品类调性：这类产品视觉语言已经很成熟，大量参考 Everlane / Away / Calpak 这些品牌的视觉
